paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : figure
model_annotation: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by researcher location across a span of years. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Year," and displays values in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and employs a logarithmic scale (base 10), with major tick labels marked at $10^0$, $10^1$, and $10^2$, alongside horizontal grid lines at these intervals. The bars are grouped by year, with individual bars within each group placed side-by-side to represent different researcher locations. A legend titled "Researcher Location" maps colors to specific regions: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). Within each year, the bars are arranged in the order presented by the legend, though not all regions are present in every year. The chart shows sparse data in early years, with the lowest plotted value of $10^0$ (1) occurring in multiple instances, such as USA in 2014, DE in 2015, IN in 2017, and IT in 2022. The tallest bar corresponds to the "Other" category in 2021, extending slightly above the $10^2$ line to an approximate value of 120. Visually, the groups are sorted chronologically along the horizontal axis, and the bars for the final year, 2022, are distinctively rendered in faded, desaturated shades of their respective categorical colors, contrasting with the solid, opaque colors used for all previous years from 2012 to 2021.
